entities.summary: Indiana Richard Alexander Neidell is an American-Swedish documentarian, historian, actor, voice actor, musician and YouTube personality, best known for presenting the video series The Great War on The Great War Channel, which documented World War I in real time using modern research, various secondary sources and archival footage. A similar project, World War Two, began in September 2018; and another one, called The Korean War, began in June 2024. Neidell is also a writer and actor with credits that include Metropia and numerous commercials in Europe, as well as video game voice-acting.
